follow-up time: Through subsequent pregnancy for some patients
cohort: 74 patients with pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum at a tertiary care center
finding: While focal-occult placenta accreta spectrum presented with fewer identifiable risk factors than previa-associated placenta accreta spectrum, it was associated with a higher incidence of reoperation and potentially linked to IVF pregnancies.
gest_age: 36.1 weeks for focal-occult group, 33.9 weeks for previa-associated group
